name: Flourishing Qi deals damage equal to champion level to target unit
notes: Flourishing Qi is a TERA (advanced element) ACTION card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real TERA champion (Silvie, Slime Sovereign) to unlock element access, reused from everlonging-thorns-debuff. The champion's Counters are also patched with 2 level counters so the LV-based damage resolves to a nonzero 2, instead of the default level-0 base of 0. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 4-reserve cost is paid, and the ability's own MZCHOOSE target decision appears directly after the last reserve payment with no separate opportunity-window PASS needed. Only the base LV damage is covered; the charge-counter accumulation clause (from a Shifting Currents direction change to North while this activation is on the stack) is out of scope.

rulesClauses: Deal LV+X damage to target unit, where X is the amount of charge counters on this card's activation.
